note:
Calls held in all 8 quarters. Q2 FY25, Q3 FY25 and Q4 FY25 were read from the company transcript PDFs (adanipower.com). Q1 FY26 to Q1 FY27 were read from AlphaStreet third-party transcripts because the company and BSE PDFs returned 403; those quotes should be spot-checked against the filed transcripts. Outcomes are taken from company results releases, NSE filings, the Ministry of Coal release and later call transcripts. Override test (backbone §4 SEVERE: could permanently impair capital, end a revenue stream, or make reported numbers unreliable) was applied to every contradicted class-10 assurance; none met it, so no call was forced to 0 by override.
v1.2 rule-7 re-grade: added Q4 FY24 (outside_window; NSE transcript) holding Mahan II timeline origin and Godda receivables assurance (0, moved from Q2 FY25); folded 24 restatements into originating items; Q3 FY25 'on schedule' assurance folded into Mahan origin (0 -> ungraded, call now pending); Korba origin (Q2 FY25) graded 0 as an unreasoned cut; FY27 ~3 GW (Q2 FY26) graded 1 as a reasoned cut. Rule 6: no Reg. 30 impact lines in file, none removed. Q1 FY25 transcript not opened (BSE blocked); PLF, WACD, Uttarakhand, Godda-grid, Coastal items not traced. score_10 missing (implied 7.4) -> 8.2.
